# Group

The groups of the host. `osapi dsl behavior get --name group` and
`osapi dsl behavior method get` show the same.

## Method list

|             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |

| Name        | list                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Verb        | read                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Description | List the groups of the host                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Detail      | Lists each group with its ID and its members, by name, from /etc/group through gohai, on every platform. The members are the users that /etc/group names; a user whose primary group it is is not listed again. |
| HTTP        | GET                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Route       | /api/node/&#123;hostname&#125;/group                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Permission  | group:read                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Command     | [osapi client node group list](../../../../usage/cli/client/node/group/list.md)                                                                                                                                 |
| Input type  | ListInput                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Output type | \[]Account                                                                                                                                                                                                      |

### Input (0)

None. The method takes no input; its command needs only --target.

### Output (3)

| FIELD   | TYPE    | DESCRIPTION                                                          |
| ------- | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| name    | string  | The group                                                            |
| gid     | integer | Its numeric group ID                                                 |
| members | array   | The users it has as members, besides those whose primary group it is |

## Method create

|             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| ----------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Name        | create                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Verb        | write                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Description | Add a group                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Detail      | Adds the group with groupadd, with the ID when one is given. A group that the host has already does not change and reports changed: false, whatever its ID. It runs on the Debian family only, and elsewhere reports skipped. |
| HTTP        | POST                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Route       | /api/node/&#123;hostname&#125;/group                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Permission  | group:write                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Command     | [osapi client node group create](../../../../usage/cli/client/node/group/create.md)                                                                                                                                           |
| Input type  | CreateInput                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Output type | Result                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |

### Input (3)

| FIELD  | TYPE    | REQUIRED | CONSTRAINTS                                      | DESCRIPTION                                                |
| ------ | ------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| name   | string  | yes      | pattern ^\[a-z_]\[a-z0-9_-]\*\$?$, max length 32 | The group to add, such as developers                       |
| gid    | integer | no       | min 0                                            | Its numeric group ID; the system assigns one when it is 0  |
| system | boolean | no       |                                                  | Add it as a system group, with an ID from the system range |

### Output (2)

| FIELD   | TYPE    | DESCRIPTION              |
| ------- | ------- | ------------------------ |
| name    | string  | The group                |
| changed | boolean | Whether the host changed |

### Examples (3)

| EXAMPLE                        | INPUT                                 | OUTPUT                        |
| ------------------------------ | ------------------------------------- | ----------------------------- |
| Add a group                    | name=osapitest                        | name=osapitest, changed=true  |
| Add a system group with its ID | name=osapitest, gid=1999, system=true | name=osapitest, changed=true  |
| A group that the host has      | name=osapitest                        | name=osapitest, changed=false |

## Method update

|             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| ----------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Name        | update                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Verb        | write                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Description | Set the members of a group                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Detail      | Sets the members with gpasswd -M, in place of the members that the group has. The same members, in any order, do not change it and report changed: false. A group that the host does not have is not found. It runs on the Debian family only, and elsewhere reports skipped. |
| HTTP        | PUT                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Route       | /api/node/&#123;hostname&#125;/group/&#123;name&#125;                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Permission  | group:write                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Command     | [osapi client node group update](../../../../usage/cli/client/node/group/update.md)                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Input type  | UpdateInput                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Output type | Result                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |

### Input (2)

| FIELD   | TYPE   | REQUIRED | CONSTRAINTS                                      | DESCRIPTION                                                    |
| ------- | ------ | -------- | ------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| name    | string | yes      | pattern ^\[a-z_]\[a-z0-9_-]\*\$?$, max length 32 | The group, such as developers                                  |
| members | array  | no       |                                                  | Its members, which replace the members it has; none when empty |

### Output (2)

| FIELD   | TYPE    | DESCRIPTION              |
| ------- | ------- | ------------------------ |
| name    | string  | The group                |
| changed | boolean | Whether the host changed |

### Examples (2)

| EXAMPLE            | INPUT                           | OUTPUT                        |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------- | ----------------------------- |
| Set the members    | name=osapitest, members=\[root] | name=osapitest, changed=true  |
| The members it has | name=osapitest, members=\[root] | name=osapitest, changed=false |
